title: SEE: Structure-aware Exploring & Exploiting for Long-horizon GUI Agent Trajectory Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2607.18046v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents powered by vision-language models hold promise for automating real-world mobile tasks. However, progress is limited by the lack of high-coverage, long-horizon interaction trajectories collected from element-rich and rapidly evolving apps. Existing pipelines often rely on costly human demonstrations or on-policy framework, which tends to over-sample common flows while missing rare transitions and complex multi-step procedures. To address this problem, we propose SEE, a two-stage data synthesis framework consisting of (i) an efficient exploration stage that builds an explicit UI transition graph over screens and elements, and (ii) a graph-based synthesis stage that composes diverse multi-step trajectories via planning and controlled sampling. This design yields reproducible and explainable data generation, while explicitly preventing spurious cycles and enabling long-horizon composition. Across mul

translated_title: SEE：面向长时程GUI智能体轨迹合成的结构感知探索与利用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.18046v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：由视觉语言模型驱动的图形用户界面（GUI）智能体有望实现真实世界移动任务的自动化。然而，由于缺乏从元素丰富且快速演变的应用程序中收集的高覆盖、长时程交互轨迹，进展受到限制。现有流水线通常依赖昂贵的人类演示或策略内框架，这往往过度采样常见流程，而遗漏稀有转换和复杂多步骤过程。为解决此问题，我们提出SEE，一种两阶段数据合成框架，包括：（i）高效探索阶段，在屏幕和元素上构建显式UI转换图；（ii）基于图的合成阶段，通过规划和受控采样组合多样化的多步骤轨迹。该设计实现了可复现且可解释的数据生成，同时明确防止虚假循环并支持长时程组合。在多个实验中，结果均表明其有效性。
tldr: 本文提出SEE框架，通过构建显式UI转换图并利用图规划合成多样化长时程轨迹，以低成本生成高覆盖、可解释的GUI交互数据，解决现有数据合成中的覆盖不足和循环问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SEE, a framework that builds an explicit UI transition graph and uses graph-based planning to synthesize diverse long-horizon trajectories, enabling low-cost, high-coverage, and explainable GUI data generation while addressing coverage gaps and spurious cycles.
